root_cause: The original AI connector wizard had one template at a time, default all-field mapping and no page-specific destinations. The original connector datahub target only dry-tests payload mapping and cannot prove any tenant-specific source record was ingested into the customer Brain, Powerhouse or Portal.
fix: Reuse original connector definitions and tenant-scoped API for multi-field, multi-page choices; preserve each connector as a separate server-side draft; implement bounded safe-test recovery advice; show non-sensitive connector provenance on opted-in pages without fabricating business records. No unauthorized AI processing or new ingestion writer.
prevention_rules: One customer connector can target multiple approved Portal V2 pages and select explicit source fields; browser-submitted arbitrary routes and field names are denied server-side.
Sovereignty/tenant isolation is mandatory; CONNECTION_ONLY has no portal outputs and the Brain destination requires PORTAL_AI permission.

No safe-test sample, configuration, provider readiness or draft becomes customer KPI, order, Brain memory, Powerhouse action or true live ingestion without independently authenticated source receipt, target persistence and consent evidence.
Recover transient, idempotent safe-test errors with at most one retry; do not self-grant provider OAuth, access, paid entitlements or cross-border transfer.
Reuse original connector store, ONE BRAIN incident, Heartbeat, original Portal V2 route and protected release writer; prohibit parallel scheduler, store or fake green.
owner: existing Portal V2 UX + canonical connector owner + ONE BRAIN/Heartbeat + Security/data-sovereignty
